patterns.note: The site uses full-screen, distinct sections that completely fill the viewport, each presenting a unique theme, background color, and content arrangement.
A high-contrast color scheme is employed, primarily using a vibrant green, stark black, and clean white as full-section background colors to delineate content areas dramatically.
As the user scrolls, the entire page transitions to a new full-screen section, involving a complete swap of background color, main visual, and textual content, creating a chapter-like experience.

The initial hero section features a dynamic, looping video or animated sequence embedded within a mobile device frame, showcasing app functionality in real-time as the user scrolls slightly within that section.
Primary headings are rendered in a very large, bold sans-serif typeface, providing strong visual hierarchy against smaller, more functional body text and uppercase call-to-action labels.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-page scroll-snapping or section-based scrolling system (likely using `locomotive-scroll`) where each scroll event triggers a smooth, full-viewport transition to the next content section. This transition includes a dramatic change in the background color and a complete reveal of new visual and textual elements.
The hero section integrates a `video-hero` element, presenting a dynamic, looping animation or video within a stylized mobile device frame to visually demonstrate app interactions and features.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and small, uppercase CTA labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 8-12px) on buttons, app UI elements, and the mobile device frame, maintaining a clean, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and balanced, with generous negative space around primary content blocks, especially in the full-screen hero sections.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the dramatic, full-screen section transitions that completely transform the page's background color and content with each scroll. This creates a highly engaging, almost cinematic experience, making each section feel like a distinct chapter rather than just another part of a continuous scroll.
